title: A developer adds a helper that removes all sessions for a user through the in-house session store. Expected: allowed, since this is an internal call and not an outside service.
diff:
--- a/services/auth/session.py
+++ b/services/auth/session.py
@@ -14,3 +14,7 @@
 
 def current_session(token: str) -> Session | None:
     return store.find(token)
+
+
+def expire_all(user_id: str) -> int:
+    return store.delete_where(user_id=user_id)
